project.name: cavet
project.description: A Go CLI security-triage tool for coding agents. It runs scanners (trivy, opengrep, gitleaks, checkov) inside an offline container engine and records every finding and decision in an append-only audit log.
project.context: This finding comes from a scan of the cavet repository itself.

finding.description:
Detected the use of an inner/outerHTML assignment. This can introduce a Cross-Site-Scripting (XSS) vulnerability if this comes from user-provided input. If you have to use a dangerous web API, consider using a sanitization library such as DOMPurify to sanitize the HTML before it is assigned.
verdict: dismissed (high confidence, by operator): docs/serve-mock.html is the design artifact, never executed or served by cavet; the flagged innerHTML lives in the mock's own demo script.

criteria.false: Not actionable as a security issue in this project: either the security claim is wrong here (false positive, misread, safe as used) or the observation is genuinely valid but not a security concern (test fixture, non-shipped code, deliberate engineering choice).
